description: A black case sits on the table in front of you, with a small plush toy, a rubber duck, two small clear pill bottles, and a gray remote-like device nearby. The right hand reaches in to open the case lid, removes the plush toy, the duck, the remote-like item, and two small bottles onto the table, then picks the bottles and the duck back up one by one and puts them into the open case while the left hand stays resting on the table without touching any objects.
